description: A recursive walk of length \(n\) is equivalent to an actual tuple indexed by \(\{0,\ldots,n\}\), with the prescribed endpoints and a relation step between every two successive coordinates. This includes length zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.walk_iff_tuple.{u} {M : Type u} {r : M → M → Prop} (n : ℕ) (a b : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.Walk r n a b ↔
    ∃ f, f 0 = a ∧ f (Fin.last n) = b ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), r (f i.castSucc) (f i.succ)
